mapper.select: SELECT ooi.id, ooi.outbound_id, ooi.sku_id, ooi.sku_code, ooi.sku_name, ps.size_value AS size_value, ooi.quantity, ooi.picked_qty, ooi.shelf_id, ooi.scanned, ooi.created_at, ooi.updated_at FROM outbound_order_item ooi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON ooi.sku_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE ooi.outbound_id = #{outboundId} ORDER BY ooi.id ASC

SELECT ooi.id, ooi.outbound_id, ooi.sku_id, ooi.sku_code, ooi.sku_name, ps.size_value AS size_value, ooi.quantity, ooi.picked_qty, ooi.shelf_id, ooi.scanned, ooi.created_at, ooi.updated_at FROM outbound_order_item ooi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON ooi.sku_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE ooi.id = #{id}

SELECT ooi.id, ooi.outbound_id, ooi.sku_id, ooi.sku_code, ooi.sku_name, ps.size_value AS size_value, ooi.quantity, ooi.picked_qty, ooi.shelf_id, ooi.scanned, ooi.created_at, ooi.updated_at FROM outbound_order_item ooi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON ooi.sku_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE ooi.outbound_id = #{outboundId} AND ooi.sku_code = #{skuCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound_order_item (outbound_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, quantity, shelf_id) VALUES (#{outboundId}, #{skuId}, #{skuCode}, #{skuName}, #{quantity}, #{shelfId})
